root_cause.label: FACT

root_cause.label: FACT

tests.name: test_native_adapter_closes_run_sqlite_before_observer
tests.assertions: Run actual unchanged draft/worker/repository once; immediately sample current run FD before any observer SQL, then explicit-close observer and sample again; assert both empty independently of outer status, persist snapshots before assertions. No stub native runtime; after fix leases=0/heartbeat=[] and receipt DB hash equals actual file after all ownership is closed.

tests.name: test_sqlite_summary_closes_owned_connection
tests.assertions: Real scratch DB/schema plus narrow TrackingConnection held strongly by test so explicit close is distinguishable from GC; exactly one close on all paths. Inject sentinel error once at first table COUNT, VACUUM or final checkpoint respectively; original sentinel propagates and no successful summary manufactured. Success _path_hash spy asserts close already occurred and delegates real hash; returned hash matches file; no same-run FDs. Never run gc.collect.

tests.name: test_native_audit_observer_closes_own_connection
tests.assertions: Fresh dedicated tiny lease table initialized then setup connection explicitly closed; pre-observer FD set empty, observer succeeds or raises sentinel then finally closes its own real tracked connection, post-close FD empty. Validate observer in isolation, not by closing any production connection; captures owner/call logs. No adapter needed here.
